summary: Fayette County, TN tower on NHLR as an 80 ft Aermotor LS-40 administered by TN Division of Forestry; build date and builder not found; Ebenezer link unconfirmed.

events.note: Registered August 6, 2023 on the National Historic Lookout Register as US 1752, TN 56

corrections.proposed: Ebenezer (unofficial name from the tnlandforms compiler; identity with this site not confirmed)
corrections.why: The compiler says these are unofficial names given to towers that USGS maps and state lists did not name, and the NHLR page does not use the name

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register gives 577 ft (176 m), which matches the record's 175.9 m. The compiler's table gives 594 ft for the Ebenezer entry. We keep the Register's figure and do not treat the two entries as confirmed to be the same site.

notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, or purpose found on the NHLR page or the tnlandforms table. Two web searches gave nothing on this tower. Results were unrelated genealogy pages and a TowerDex FCC-registry entry for a 275.9 ft structure in Williston, which is probably a communications tower, not this lookout. Ebenezer identity with this site is unconfirmed. Access level left unset: the Register calls the site an active TN Forestry site but describes no visiting arrangement. Possible follow-up: Tennessee Division of Forestry records for Fayette County, Fayette County archives, Tennessee State Library and Archives.
